# discord_invite (Data Source)

Reads a Discord invite by code.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_invite" "welcome" {
  code = "abcd1234"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) The invite code to read.

### Read-Only

- `channel_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the invite's channel.
- `guild_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the invite's guild.
- `url` (String) The full invite URL.
